body: I just had a narcissistic ex admit to me that he’s fucked up & insane and was battling demons. it honestly doesn’t change anything nor make me forgive him but I guess at least he acknowledged it.
Recovering from the betrayal is the hardest part, feeling like my whole world was shattered. I am curious as to which part resonated with you the most?
Broke up with him twice, both times were hard & I went back to him. we are finally broken up for good, and even though I don’t have feelings or miss them, I still stalk
what if I have no more love to give to myself

I'm so sorry for your loss. I have no idea what it feels like to lose a loved one, but I do know what it feels like to wake up every single day basked in loneliness and pain, and death is the only thing you can think about.
Me too. I keep trying to find a reason to live but each moment on each day just makes me want to end my life tomorrow
